correctness.rationale: The live core/pendant edge counts establish the exact transition probability \(p_k=2w/(k-1+2w)\), including the forced final pendant transition. The paired-level visit bound proves \(A_n=w\log n+O_{L^2}(1)\) for fixed weight and \(Q_n/\log n\to w\); bounded-increment martingale convergence gives the Gaussian limit and the correct variance scale. In the weak regime \(w_n\log n\to c\), the predictable hazard converges to \(c\) with vanishing squared hazards, yielding a Poisson law plus the exact parity correction. value.rationale: The complete core has quadratically many edges while each site has one private pendant edge: a natural hierarchy of adsorption rates. The precise \(w\log n\) leaf-deposition scale, Gaussian fluctuations, and a distinct parity-folded Poisson law when \(w_n\log n\to c\) quantify terminal jamming defects not visible in limiting occupancy density. The finite weighted generating recurrence yields reproducible full-size distributions, and the crossover is structural rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
